hero.title: Make Your QR Menu Match Your Restaurant Brand
hero.subtitle: Pick your brand color, and your entire menu — buttons, highlights, links — updates instantly. Light and dark themes included.
hero.noCreditCard: No credit card required. Free plan available.

features.title: How Custom Branding Works
features.subtitle: Your menu, your colors — consistent across every page.

items.title: Choose Your Accent Color
items.description: Select from 12 curated presets or enter your exact brand color with a hex code. Every button, link, and highlight on your menu adapts instantly — no design skills needed.

items.title: Automatic Light & Dark Themes
items.description: Your menu automatically supports both light and dark mode. The system ensures your brand color looks great in both themes with optimized contrast and readability.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about menu customization.

items.question: Can I use my exact brand color?
items.answer: Yes. Enter any hex color code, or choose from 12 carefully selected presets. Your accent color applies across all pages of your menu.

items.question: Does it work with dark mode?
items.answer: Yes. Your color scheme automatically adapts to both light and dark themes. The system adjusts contrast to keep your menu readable and beautiful in any mode.

items.question: Can I change colors after publishing?
items.answer: Absolutely. Change your accent color anytime from the dashboard. Updates appear instantly on your live menu — no republishing needed.

items.question: Will my QR code match the brand colors too?
items.answer: Your QR code is generated separately and can be customized independently. The accent color applies to your digital menu pages, navigation, and interactive elements.
